meta.title: Responses — vertical and horizontal layout
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on its Responses tab.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Establish that both bids are present before changing the grid layout.
Switch the Responses grid to the vertical layout.
Verify both bids remain visible after the vertical layout switch.
Switch the Responses grid to the horizontal layout.
Verify both bids remain visible after the horizontal layout switch.
